entries.title: Review carefully from a merge card
entries.body: When a merge card looks risky, press Review carefully, or ⌘2, beside Merge. The task becomes Careful: an independent reviewer reads the work and the card you were reading, and a new merge card comes back once the review passes. The pull request stays as it is until then.

picture.alt: A merge card with Discard, Review carefully and Merge the pull request, keyed ⌘3, ⌘2 and ⌘1
